sponsors.title: Corporate Sponsors
sponsors.description: These organizations support animal welfare through qualified corporate sponsorships under IRC § 513(i).
sponsors.compliance_body: Sponsor acknowledgments are displayed as value-neutral references in compliance with the Qualified Sponsorship Payment safe harbor. No advertising, endorsement, pricing, or calls to action are rendered. This classification ensures income remains exempt from Unrelated Business Income Tax (UBIT) for 501(c)(3) tenants.

quick_links.surrender_body: Found a stray or need to surrender a pet? Our ESIGN/UETA-compliant electronic waiver creates a legally defensible chain of custody.
quick_links.fundraising_body: Support urgent medical care, surgery, and recovery costs for shelter animals. Every donation is tracked with legal restriction flags to prevent fund mixing.
